PLAY · RAINBOW COLOR ORDER

Rainbow Weather Machine

The weather machine shows a color chip. Pick that color, then tap the arc it asks for.

The machine wants red for the biggest arc!

Somewhere over the rainbow!

Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple — you know the rainbow order!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this activity helps.

This studio turns rainbow color order into open-ended making. Children choose, tap and see the picture answer at once — and because nothing is graded, the choices are truly theirs. Naming colors out loud as they work doubles the learning, and the undo button means a brave choice is never a risk.

Finished pieces can be saved to the selected child’s My Classroom desk or downloaded as a picture to print. Save buttons appear under the board; everything stays on this device, private by design.
